input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP package meets the preferred position in full. § 14.2 gives Customer ownership of each Deliverable and a present assignment by Vendor of all worldwide right, title and interest. § 14.3 confirms Vendor retains only Vendor Technology (defined in § 1.9 as its pre-existing technology, excluding Customer Data and Customer's pre-existing IP), and applies the § 13.2 licence to embedded Vendor Technology, which is "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid" and permits use, modification, derivative works and contractor support for Customer's business. § 14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data and Customer-provided material, with "No right transfers to Vendor except the limited right to process that material solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer" — processing to deliver, secure, support and improve the Services for Customer is service delivery, not independent exploitation, so the Vendor-side data licence is appropriately confined; § 15.1 further bars sale, advertising use, data combination and model training. § 14.4 provides that no jointly owned IP is created absent a separate signed instrument that fixes exploitation rights, so there is no unrestricted joint ownership. Minor points noted but not redlined: Deliverable ownership is expressed as "subject to payment of the applicable Fees", and § 15.1's "as permitted by this Agreement" is a general cross-reference rather than a standalone licence. No assignment of Customer IP or Customer Data to Vendor exists, so no change is required.
